title: About
text:
Project
FaceGate is a cross-platform desktop application and CLI suite for:

enrolling and recognizing faces (webcam or photos)
optional pupil segmentation and gaze estimation
session performance metrics

Built with Python, OpenCV, InsightFace, and Tkinter. Documentation is authored in Quarto and published via GitHub Pages.

title: Modules
text:
Pipeline stages
When you run python app/run_pipeline.py --recognize:

webcam-capture — grab frame

camera-calibration — optional undistortion

face-recognition — detect (+ identify)

pupil-segmentation — eye ROI + pupils

gaze-estimation — pointer if a model exists

performance-metrics — HUD / JSONL log

title: Getting started
text:
Install

Linux / macOS
git clone https://github.com/mohamadysn/FaceGate.git
cd FaceGate
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt


Windows
git clone https://github.com/mohamadysn/FaceGate.git
cd FaceGate
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
Optional training extras (ArcFace / RetinaFace remakes):
pip install -r requirements-train.txt

title: Desktop application
text:
Photo editor
When enrolling from images you can:

Zoom (scroll / buttons)
Pan (drag)
Crop (draw rectangle → Apply crop)
Rotate 90°
Reset / navigate multi-image batches

title: Desktop application
text:
Merge vs replace
For someone already in the gallery:

Add to person — blend new embeddings into the existing profile
Replace completely — overwrite the stored identity

title: CLI reference
text: Run all commands from eye-tracking/ with the virtualenv activated.

title: CLI reference
text:
Enroll (webcam)
python face-recognition/enroll.py --name Alice --provider CPUExecutionProvider
Captures NEAR then FAR samples with quality checks.

title: CLI reference
text:
Enroll (images)
python face-recognition/enroll_image.py --name Alice --images photo1.jpg photo2.png
python face-recognition/enroll_image.py --name Alice --images ./photos_alice/

title: CLI reference
text:
Live recognition
python face-recognition/recognize_live.py --profile balanced --provider CPUExecutionProvider
python face-recognition/recognize_live.py --profile fast
python face-recognition/recognize_live.py --profile accurate
Useful flags: --camera, --threshold, --max-faces, --min-face-ratio, --no-mirror.

title: CLI reference
text:
Recognize a still image
python face-recognition/recognize_image.py --image test.jpg --show
python face-recognition/recognize_image.py --image test.jpg --save out.jpg

title: CLI reference
text:
Unified pipeline
python app/run_pipeline.py --recognize --provider CPUExecutionProvider
python app/run_pipeline.py --recognize --enable-log

title: CLI reference
text:
Calibration & gaze (optional)
python camera-calibration/take_photo.py
python camera-calibration/calibration.py
python gaze-estimation/run_calibration.py
python pupil-segmentation/run_demo.py

title: FaceGate
text:
Architecture (high level)





flowchart LR
  Cam[Webcam / photos] --> App[Desktop app / CLI]
  App --> Det[Face detect]
  Det --> Emb[Embeddings]
  Emb --> Gal[(Gallery JSON + NPY)]
  Emb --> Match[Cosine match]
  Match --> UI[Identity overlay]
  Det --> Pupil[Pupil / gaze optional]

title: FaceGate
text:
License & privacy
The on-disk gallery stores embeddings only (no face photos). Do not commit personal gallery.json / embeddings.npy files.
